# Every key of the `HostClassDecl` JSON the SDKs send the poll core, one per
# line, `section.key` for the nested declarations. `class.run` and
# `class.durable` carry the settings tree as its JSON (`flz_core`'s
# `relay::settings`), which the core reads and refuses by the member's
# name. Seven readers pin it: a `flz_core` test serialises a fully populated declaration and asserts its key
# set is exactly this; `HostClassDeclarationTest` asserts the Java builder emits
# every key here; `sdk/node/test/decl-keys.test.mjs` asserts the same of the
# Node builder; `sdk/ruby/test/decl_keys_test.rb` of the Ruby builder;
# `sdk/php/tests/DeclKeysTest.php` of the PHP builder;
# `sdk/python/tests/test_decl_keys.py` of the Python builder; and
# `sdk/elixir/test/flezha/sdk/declaration_test.exs` that the Elixir builder
# spells no key outside it. A key the core
# learns that a builder cannot spell is a red build for that SDK; a key a
# builder invents that the core never learned already fails at
# `deny_unknown_fields`.
#
# Adding a key: teach the core, add it here, teach the Rust, Java, Node, Ruby,
# PHP, Python and Elixir builders — one change, every SDK (docs/public/architecture/runner.md).
class.factory_id
class.description
class.max_duration_ms
class.run
class.durable
class.sdk_lang
class.sdk_version
class.change_format_id
class.compact_after_bytes
class.channels
